## Type of change

<!-- Keep the relevant box(es) checked, matching your commit type. -->

- [ ] feat — new capability
- [ ] fix — defect correction
- [ ] refactor — no behavior change
- [ ] perf — performance improvement
- [ ] docs — documentation only
- [ ] build / ci — tooling or pipeline
- [ ] test — tests only
- [ ] chore — maintenance

## Scope

- [ ] `apps/web`
- [ ] `apps/api`
- [ ] `packages/*`
- [ ] Root / tooling / docs

## Checklist

- [ ] I ran `pnpm lint` and `pnpm typecheck` on all affected workspaces
- [ ] I ran `pnpm format` and no unexpected diffs remain
- [ ] Tests cover the change (`pnpm test` passes) — or tests are not applicable
- [ ] `.env.example` files are updated if environment variables changed
- [ ] Docs are updated (`README.md` / `docs/`) if user-facing behavior changed
- [ ] No secrets or local environment values are committed
